  "question": "Has Cipher Borough's operating change resolved the question about backup recovery? Focus on: The September full-restore duration and whether restored records passed the completeness check.",

    "The useful comparison depends on keeping the time window, unit and population consistent.

Cipher's witnessed restore report records a full restore in 6 hours on 22 September with 100% of sampled records present; the eight-hour recovery target was met.

Background to the observation: Cipher installed an additional backup vault.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
